name: DTSI datacenters (Governatorato S.C.V. public-sector ICT infrastructure)
developer: Governatorato S.C.V. - Direzione delle Telecomunicazioni e dei Sistemi Informatici (DTSI)
notes: Official vaticanstate.va interviews with DTSI director (2024-07-11: responsibilities include 'gestione di datacenter'; 2026-02-17: data resides and is processed in 'datacenter presenti nello Stato', datacenter areas being engineered 'AI ready', and further server clusters are planned on the 'tre siti fisici' (three physical sites) that constitute the backbone application infrastructure). Public-sector datacenters officially confirmed inside Vatican City State; precise locations, addresses and capacity undisclosed (capacity_mw null). No commercial colocation or public cloud region (AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI lists contain no VA region, A-grade negative).

name: Vatican Internet Service Provider / .va DNS infrastructure
developer: Holy See - Vatican City State (Governatorato S.C.V.), Department of Telecommunications / Vatican ISP
notes: IANA .va delegation record (last updated 2024-12-03, checked 2026-08-12): ccTLD manager Holy See - Vatican City State / Governatorato S.C.V.; administrative contact Department of Telecommunications (Palazzo del Belvedere); technical contact Vatican Internet Service Provider (Cortile del Triangolo); authoritative name servers a/b/c.nic.va plus osiris/seth.namex.it. A-grade network identity evidence for the State's official network/DNS infrastructure; contact addresses are NOT datacenter addresses and are not recorded as facility locations.

name: Vatican Apostolic Library digital infrastructure (NTT DATA AMLAD digitization)
notes: NTT DATA official press release (2024-05-13): since 2014 NTT DATA built the AMLAD cloud-based digital storage system and infrastructure for long-term storage, preservation and display of the Vatican Library's heritage; over 27,500 manuscripts available online in high definition. Digitization infrastructure (storage/compute lead), NOT a commercial colocation facility; capacity recorded via manuscript/page indicators only, not converted to MW.

name: Vatican Apostolic Archive digital services
notes: Archive official site confirms the institution and its digital services; A-grade for institution existence but facility-level datacenter evidence is insufficient (no official server-room/data-center disclosure).
